name: browser-use
headline: awesome moltbot skills for intelligent automation
short_description: A collection of 700+ community-built skills for Claude agents. Enables automation of tasks, workflows, and processes. Benefits operations teams by streamlining repetitive tasks and integrating with various tools.
author: VoltAgent

sections.overview:
awesome-moltbot-skills is a comprehensive directory of over 5,300 community-contributed skills designed for OpenClaw agents. The collection is organized by category to help developers quickly find and implement pre-built automations for common tasks and workflows. Skills cover a wide range of integrations and use cases, enabling operations teams to streamline repetitive processes without building from scratch. The repository is actively maintained and regularly updated with new community contributions. Developers can browse, discover, and integrate skills to extend agent capabilities across various platforms and tools.
Automate the fetching and processing of RSS feeds from a Miniflux instance.
Control and manage interactions with Discord or Slack directly from Moltbot.
Perform automated UI audits to ensure compliance with UX principles and guidelines.
Streamline DevOps tasks by utilizing skills for cloud management and server orchestration.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-moltbot-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Use the [awesome-moltbot-skills] collection to automate [SPECIFIC_TASK] in [TOOL_OR_PLATFORM]. Focus on [KEY_OBJECTIVE], such as reducing manual steps or improving accuracy. Reference the most relevant skill from the collection (e.g., 'email-sorter-v2' or 'data-cleaner-3000') and explain how it will achieve the goal.
```
Copy

```
For the marketing team at GreenLeaf Organics, I automated the weekly email newsletter signup processing using the 'email-sorter-v2' skill from the [awesome-moltbot-skills] collection. The workflow now processes 1,200 new signups daily, categorizing them into segments (e.g., 'Produce Lovers', 'Bakery Enthusiasts') and triggering personalized welcome sequences in Mailchimp. Previously, this took 3-4 hours of manual work by two team members; now it runs in under 5 minutes with zero errors. The skill also logs skipped entries (e.g., invalid emails) to a Google Sheet for review, reducing bounce rates by 18% in the first month. The automation integrates seamlessly with Zapier, so new signups from the website, social media, and in-store kiosks are all handled uniformly.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
